title: Frozen Hope a Poem for @RobinDerosa #digped #clmooc #openpedagogy

author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Stasis of
permanent change
permeates in
deranged winds
blowing against
logic lost, tossed
in permafrost of time


policies picked over
people
pick over policies


students struggle
frostbitten faces trudging
the tundra
as wind whipped realities
drop pressures
 to pay,
learn, survive
motions that can not
be tabled


treeless mountain track
direction lost, battles fought
all for naught
like
languages of Kildin Sámi
hope fades
poppping like pingos

No task force
but teachers,
scholars of care
can whisp away
frosty air

you are the hearth
the fire in which we
gather
for in your arms we
see a shelter
for the masses
